import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert the 'Dt_Customer' column to datetime
customer_segments['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(customer_segments['Dt_Customer'])

# Convert the 'Year_Birth' column to datetime
customer_segments['Year_Birth'] = pd.to_datetime(customer_segments['Year_Birth'], format='%Y')

# Calculate the age of each customer
customer_segments['Age'] = customer_segments['Year_Birth'].dt.year - customer_segments['Dt_Customer'].dt.year

# Plot a histogram of the age of customers
sns.histplot(data=customer_segments, x='Age', bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title('Age Distribution of Customers')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.legend(title='Kernel Density Estimation')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert the 'Dt_Customer' column to datetime
customer_segments['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(customer_segments['Dt_Customer'])

# Convert the 'Year_Birth' column to datetime
customer_segments['Year_Birth'] = pd.to_datetime(customer_segments['Year_Birth'], format='%Y')

# Calculate the age of each customer
customer_segments['Age'] = customer_segments['Year_Birth'].dt.year - customer_segments['Dt_Customer'].dt.year

# Plot a histogram of the age of customers
sns.histplot(data=customer_segments, x='Age', bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title('Age Distribution of Customers')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.legend(title='Kernel Density Estimation')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
